story.title: Story 3: Turn Composition and Chunk Formation

result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on prior finding SV-3.8-001 and directly touched surfaces for AC-3.8/TC-3.8. The implementor added mechanical tool-run receipts on turn_rendering metadata, differentiated detailed and brief summary provider inputs, and added a receipt/outcome fixture test. Targeted tests and configured story/epic gates pass.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: Resolved by code and tests. composeRenderingInput now returns ToolRunReceipt records in packages/lhc/src/domains/turns/internal/compose.ts:43-50 and 167-177; turn_derivation stamps them on turn_rendering.metadata in packages/lhc/src/domains/turns/internal/derive.ts:82-95; chunk summary handlers pass memberReceipts to detailed and memberOutcomes only to brief in packages/lhc/src/domains/turns/internal/derive.ts:148-159. The new TC-3.8 test in packages/lhc/test/derivation-turns.test.ts:519-585 asserts rendering metadata receipts, captured detailed input with full receipts, captured brief input with outcomes only, detailed artifact receipt content, and brief artifact outcomes without tool account content.

verified: AC-3.1 / TC-3.1: closed turn lands ready turn_rendering and lower_band_projection rows.
AC-3.2 / TC-3.2: non-ready message form fallback records a dependency gap and rendering remains ready.
AC-3.3 / TC-3.3: dependency repair does not auto-cascade; explicit rebuild clears gap.
AC-3.4 / TC-3.4: tool activity composition carries outcomes including failed calls.
AC-3.5 / TC-3.5: turn read-back exposes chunk placement.
AC-3.6 / TC-3.6: accumulated close rule excludes crossing turn and starts next chunk.
AC-3.7 / TC-3.7: max-sized turn self-chunks and closes immediately.

AC-3.8 / TC-3.8: detailed and brief summaries are separate work items with independent retry/state/requeue, and detailed now preserves tool-run receipts while brief receives and preserves outcomes only.
AC-3.9 / TC-3.9: replayed streams produce identical chunk membership and boundaries.

additionalObservations: No fake adapter, shim, placeholder, or non-real production execution path was found on the touched AC-3.8 path.
The provider seam change is additive and optional for external callers; the production chunk summary handlers always pass the differentiated fields.
